notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
-Challenge mode issues fixed
-Rewards for completing challenge modes now feature chronic nightmares for you and your loved ones

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
-Inventory/Dumbwaiter bug fixed and will now regenerate seemingly lost items in your inventory or dumbwaiter
-A certain ghost can be destroyed with certain weapons
-All-New End Credits scene for S Rank runs
-Lights added to entrances of previously all-dark rooms
-some more matches added to find
-Chance of being visited by a dead relative while you sleep up 37%

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: -Lighting/shadow rendering issue made Lobby dark on re-entry - fixed

notes.title: Another hotfix
notes.content: Looks like the expansion had more bugs than I could catch. This latest patch addresses a lot of them. If you find any more, please comment here, Discord, or Bluesky to let me know. I'm committed to fixing any and all that come up as quickly as possible.

notes.title: MAJOR EXPANSION UPDATE
notes.content:
-4 ALL-NEW rooms added to The Pines Hotel!
-New key items and old items rearranged to create new paths to solving the case
-Play time expanded roughly 2 more hours
-Credits now translated to all 10 included languages
-More stats added to post-game Grade Screen
-New player and enemy animations
-Graphics and animation fixes
-Many bug fixes, including restoring map and note functionality
-Players now more likely to see the deceased in mirrors in their own homes when the lights are off. (Be sure to say "Bloody Mary" thrice for optimal effects.)

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
-Fixed issue for game state when all candles are extinguished
-Fixed broken mirrors mechanic
-Made sure ghosts can't get the jump on you when entering new rooms; they now stay put until they notice you
-Added new smoke particle effect
-Item inspect screen now has static size, regardless of resolution
-set it so ghosts now go after YOU, the player, if Ben dies

notes.title: Quality of After Life Update
notes.content:
-some graphical updates
-brightness option range extended greatly
-default brightness brightened to be more bright
-several blood rituals done to appease the specter of death that comes for us all
-some other tweaks here and there

notes.title: Patch Notes 11/29/24
notes.content:
-fixed some lighting/graphical hiccups in guest room hallways
-shadows and tutorial messages weren't rendering properly

notes.title: GHOST at DAWN: REBUILD UPDATE INCOMING
notes.content:
I will be uploading the REBUILD update to Steam later today or tomorrow. It will erase your previous save data upon the initial boot up. Unfortunately, this was necessary because of the massive changes made to the game. If you want to finish your current run, do so before installing the new update. 

I assure you another investigation through The Pines Hotel will be worth it. There are new items, sound effects, animations, scares, enemy placements, game mechanics, options, along with a whole new look for the game. This will be the ultimate version of the game. I hope you enjoy it.

notes.title: Challenge Mode Update is Live!
notes.content: Four BRAND NEW challenges have been updated to the game. Completing them will unlock a new costume for Yuhiko and nigh unlimited ammo for the guns.

notes.title: Black screen bug fixed.
notes.content: Fixed bug that resulted in black screen immediately upon startup.
